returns.product_name: Handcrafted Chanderi Silk Anarkali Kurta Set
returns.customer_comment: Ordered Size L (40 bust) as per chart, but it's way too tight across the shoulders and chest. Can't even wear it comfortably.
returns.ai_root_cause: Kurta bodice chest circumference is 2.5 inches smaller than standard Indian ethnic wear sizing spec (Kurti chest graded 37.5" instead of 40").
returns.ai_mitigation_fix: Update size chart on Myntra/Shopify PDP with bust/shoulder measurements in inches and cm with 'Runs Small' tag.

returns.product_name: Handcrafted Chanderi Silk Anarkali Kurta Set
returns.customer_comment: Zari embroidery around neck area is coming loose and itching against the collarbone.
returns.ai_root_cause: Unbacked metallic zari thread with loose lockstitch prone to unraveling on friction.
returns.ai_mitigation_fix: Enforce soft cotton lining backing behind embroidered neckline at Surat manufacturing unit.

returns.product_name: Handcrafted Chanderi Silk Anarkali Kurta Set
returns.customer_comment: Color in picture looks royal emerald green, but received washed-out parrot green. Very disappointing for wedding wear.
returns.ai_root_cause: Studio lighting over-saturated RGB highlights creating a 22% delta on green silk fabric under natural daylight.
returns.ai_mitigation_fix: Re-shoot catalogue photography under standard 5000K daylight and add customer unboxing swatch video.

returns.product_name: Slim Fit Stretch Denim Jeans (Dark Indigo)
returns.customer_comment: Waist fits fine, but length is too long. Inseam is 34 inches, drags below heels on Indian height.
returns.ai_root_cause: Pattern graded on Western 33.5" inseam standard without Short (30") variant for Indian average height.
returns.ai_mitigation_fix: Introduce 30-inch and 32-inch inseam length options on product page.

returns.product_name: Slim Fit Stretch Denim Jeans (Dark Indigo)
returns.customer_comment: Main front copper button broke off on first trial. Rivet quality is very weak.
returns.ai_root_cause: Sub-gauge brass shank rivets failing under moderate shearing torque from Batch #IND-BLR-89.
returns.ai_mitigation_fix: Audit button rivet attachment torque at Tirupur/Bellary vendor facility.

returns.product_name: BassPro ANC Wireless Earbuds (TWS)
returns.customer_comment: Right earbud stopped charging after 3 days. Red LED blinks continuously in case. Noise cancellation makes humming noise.
returns.ai_root_cause: Pogo-pin spring contact misalignment in charging dock causing zero-voltage latch.
returns.ai_mitigation_fix: Quarantine Batch #TWS-409 and mandate charging cradle voltage verification jig at Noida assembly line.

returns.product_name: BassPro ANC Wireless Earbuds (TWS)
returns.customer_comment: Outer cardboard parcel was completely crushed by courier during transit. Left earbud shell had a hairline crack.
returns.ai_root_cause: Single-wall 3-ply corrugated box crushed under hub conveyor sorted loads by courier partner.
returns.ai_mitigation_fix: Upgrade outer shipping box to 5-ply 150 GSM corrugated carton with internal bubble pouch wrap.

returns.customer_comment: Ordered Brass Gold finish filter coffee maker, but received Stainless Steel silver. Wrong product dispatched.

returns.ai_root_cause: Shipped in poly courier flyer instead of rigid box packaging for metallic kitchenware.
returns.ai_mitigation_fix: Enforce rigid Box-in-Box packaging standard across all fragile cookware SKUs.

returns.product_name: Pure Mulberry Silk Festive Dupatta (2-Piece)
returns.customer_comment: Fabric does not feel like pure silk. Feels more like synthetic poly-georgette. Border zari is stiff.
returns.ai_root_cause: Product title states '100% Mulberry Silk' while blend is 40% Art-Silk Viscose.
returns.ai_mitigation_fix: Correct PDP specification to 'Art-Silk Festive Blend' and upload certified Silk Mark laboratory test badge.

returns.product_name: All-Terrain Cushioned Running Shoes
returns.customer_comment: Toe box is extremely narrow for Indian feet. Caused blisters during first 20 min morning walk.
returns.ai_root_cause: Last shape constructed on narrow European D-width standard rather than wide Indian EE-width last.
returns.ai_mitigation_fix: Add Wide (EE) width variant and add sizing advisory recommending sizing up for broad feet.

returns.product_name: All-Terrain Cushioned Running Shoes
returns.customer_comment: Sole separated completely from upper near the toe after 1 week of walking.
returns.ai_root_cause: Inadequate polyurethane adhesive curing time at Agra footwear contract manufacturer.
returns.ai_mitigation_fix: Issue non-conformance warning to factory and increase adhesive hot-press bonding dwell time.

returns.product_name: Kumkumadi Ayurvedic Radiance Face Oil (30ml)

returns.ai_root_cause: Dropper cap rubber teat degradation caused oxidation during high-temp transit.
